headline: Eastern Front Ignites at Stlican Shelf as Central Swings Cool
war_summary: Combat activity has pivoted sharply toward the eastern theater over the past three hours, where Stlican Shelf has erupted with accelerating casualty rates and five fresh base engagements, sustained by fierce skirmishes around Breaker Town and The Pale House. Island clashes across Godcrofts also extended into the morning watch, resulting in Colonials consolidating control over all nine regional bases following repeated contests at Ursa Base and Fleecewatch. Along the central spine, the breakneck pace of base seizures in Weathered Expanse, Linn of Mercy, and Dead Lands has visibly cooled over the past two hours, with zero strategic points changing hands despite lingering, bloody firefights that consumed thousands of men near Wightwalk, The First Coin, and The Salt March. In the west, Stonecradle and Farranac Coast report heavy attritional grinding and substantial casualty totals, yet front lines have temporarily hardened. While the central sectors digest their recent butcher's bill, the eastern archipelagos and coastal shelves remain the war desk's primary flashpoints.
